audit.whatIsWrong: content.wants.you[1] read "keep the wave near your tower so Heroic Charge only reaches a wall — not you", and the full layer summarised the ability as "Wall-pin stun. Dodge it."
audit.why: Heroic Charge is a targeted dash — it reaches you regardless of where you stand, and there is nothing to dodge. What is conditional is the STUN: Riot's text is "If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned." So the counterplay is not dodging or wave position, it is what is behind your back. Standing with open ground behind you converts her main engage into a harmless shove.
audit.corrected: Keep open ground behind you. Heroic Charge will still hit, but without a wall to pin you against there is no stun and no follow-up combo.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] attributed her durability to a "shield passive and bulk" and treated poking her down as straightforward progress.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence passively grants Armor and Magic Resist, and Riot's text states "This bonus increases when she is low on Health." Teemo's entire pattern is chip damage, so the lower Poppy gets the worse his damage converts. That inverts the usual poke logic and it was nowhere in the entry.
audit.corrected: She gains resistances as she drops — either commit to finishing her or treat the poison purely as zoning.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid claimed Poppy has "no on-hit steroids, no crit, no AD abilities that bypass blind".
audit.why: Hammer Shock and Heroic Charge are abilities and land in full through a blind. The sentence overstated what Blinding Dart buys and would leave a player surprised by the damage that still arrives after a clean blind.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart takes her auto damage, which is the bulk of the trade; Hammer Shock and Heroic Charge still land.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.wants.you[0] called her passive "Buckler Toss"; whys[2] and mid wrote Teemo's Q as "Blinding Shot".
audit.why: Poppy's passive is Iron Ambassador. Teemo's Q is Blinding Dart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Charge was tracked without a number.
audit.why: It is 14/13/12/11/10s at 475 range. Naming 14s at rank 1 gives the player the size of the window after she commits it, which is the whole basis for stepping up.
audit.corrected: Heroic Charge is 14s at rank 1 — that is your trade window once she spends it.

audit.why: 56.51% over 338 games — Teemo's best matchup in this slice.

edits.after: Full kit online: Blinding Dart blanks all of Poppy's auto damage while E poison stacks freely, and W lets you kite every Heroic Charge attempt at a safe angle.

edits.before: Level 3 is when this lane flips in your favour. Blinding Shot neutralises her entire auto-attack kit — she has no on-hit steroids, no crit, no AD abilities that bypass blind — so every trade where you Q first and W-kite the follow-up leaves her dealing zero auto damage while your E poison ticks freely. Max Q first, not E, because the blind duration is the only reason you can safely stand in her melee range at all. At 6 your shroom net makes the wall corner she needs for Heroic Charge a guaranteed reveal: shroom the wall-adjacent bushes so any approach pings you on the minimap and slows her to half speed before she closes.

notes: Two derived flags in champ-data/_kits/poppy.json look like text artifacts and I built nothing on either: "grounding" on Hammer Shock (Q), whose Riot text describes only a slowing zone that explodes, and "grounding" on Keeper's Verdict (R), which Riot's text does not mention. Steadfast Presence's anti-dash active is genuinely irrelevant here — Teemo has no dash — so per the relevance rule I wrote nothing about it. content.win gives Teemo only 1 of 7 stages in a matchup he wins at 56.51%; the packet did not flag it and I could not justify specific flips from the kits alone, but it is the clearest remaining chart mismatch in this slice.
